scientific_integrity: All supporting computations, proof steps and source-access limitations are identified. Verification of an infinite family relies on a self-contained mathematical argument rather than finite simulations.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic three-color threshold-one excitation on finite open two-row ladders only. General zero-circulation extinction theorem is previously known; no other attractors, extinction times, or wider strips classified. Exact open-ladder census may have unindexed historical equivalents.
title: Exact extinction census and boundary-sensitive spectral law for three-state excitation on open ladders
